notes.tu_identity_verification: Uses the account's default TU identity verification config (TUC3002). Read addOnProducts[0].idManagerVerification.messages: empty = verified; 2101 is TransUnion's real address-mismatch code, 2201/2202/2301/2401 texts are authored for the hackathon. KBA/OTP (TUC3004) is not mocked.
